source: User reported blue, M=C1, S=2000F and N=1 after the Route15 fresh runtime B test
procedure_requested: Cold boot, Run, release all keys, fresh B after stable blue, wait about three seconds and observe before manual Reload test
accepted_scope: One runtime Target 0192 open of the already-bound read-only synthetic seed completed successfully
The previous Route14 malformed-path error is absent with the buffered parameter implementation
The screen remained blue and M remained at the cold-start C1 marker: no automatic VM re-entry or native switch was observed
Together with Route13, both the tested read and existing-file open completed without an observed automatic switch
not_established: Exact elapsed time was not independently measured; ID, D and C were not requested or reported in this branch
The actual firmware serial trace and filename bytes were not captured
This opens the same already-bound path, not a different file or a deferred slot
This does not prove that all possible runtime re-entry interfaces are unavailable
Real game, BIOS, save and cross-core return handoff remain unimplemented or unaccepted
decision: Close the unchanged Route13/14/15 file-command trigger experiments. Preserve Route12 as the accepted OS-mediated A-to-B-to-A control and Route15 as the successful buffered-open reference. No further hardware repetition of these commands without a distinct evidence-backed mechanism.
